background: Intesa Sanpaolo is Italy's largest bank, funded by Italian retail deposits and lending to Italian households and companies, with large wealth management and insurance arms and a smaller international network in Central and Eastern Europe.
synthesis: Ratings are A- from Fitch, BBB+ from S&P on a positive outlook and A3 from Moody's after its upgrade on 25 Nov 2025. Capital is mixed against EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 13.0% is in the bottom quarter, while leverage of 5.7% is above the peer median. Liquidity is on the weak side, with LCR of 138% in the bottom quarter and NSFR of 120% below the median, and none of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods. The flagged news is all good: record earnings reported on 19 Sep 2026 and upgrades from DBRS, which with S&P's positive outlook point the same way.
